name: ViCkY Sharma
player_statement:
A complete player, ViCkY Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 78 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 49, with an average of 12.63 and a quick strike rate of 138.48. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 34 sixes and 62 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 171.4 overs, taking 105 wickets at an economy rate of 9.14. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
